Build a shared nearest-neighbour graph

Source: R/talos_graph.R
TALOS_build_graph.Rd

Constructs a SNN graph from a reduced-dimension representation using scran::buildSNNGraph. Defaults to PCA; pass use_rep = "scVI" to build the graph in the scVI latent space produced by TALOS_run_scvi. The graph is stored in metadata(sce)$snn_graph for use by TALOS_cluster.

Usage

TALOS_build_graph(
  sce,
  use_rep = "PCA",
  n_pcs = 30L,
  k = 20L,
  type = c("rank", "number", "jaccard"),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

sce

A SingleCellExperiment with the chosen reduced dimension already populated.

use_rep

Character. Name of the reducedDims slot to use. Default "PCA". Use "scVI" for the batch-corrected latent embedding from TALOS_run_scvi.

n_pcs

Integer. Number of PCA components to use when use_rep = "PCA". Ignored for other representations (all dims are used). Default 30.

k

Integer. Number of nearest neighbours. Higher values produce broader, more robust clusters. Default 20.

type

Character. Edge weight scheme: "rank" (default), "number", or "jaccard".

verbose

Logical. Print a summary. Default TRUE.

Value

SCE with metadata(sce)$snn_graph populated.
